response.reason: The cited clause, Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011 Art. 22(1)(a), specifically requires a quantitative indication (QUID) for ingredients that appear in the name of the food. The verdict turns on this requirement, stating that the product name includes 'honey' and 'almonds', and that their percentages are provided in the ingredients list. This is exactly the obligation set out in the cited clause, so the citation supports the verdict.
